# A2A (Agent2Agent) Protocol

> An open standard, hosted by the Linux Foundation, that lets independent AI agents discover each other, delegate work, and exchange results across frameworks and vendors — without exposing their internal state, memory, or tools.

The Protobuf definition in `specification/a2a.proto` is the normative source of truth; every page below explains or implements it. The current released version is `1.0.0`.

- Bindings: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP (with Server-Sent Events), gRPC, and HTTP/REST.
- Core objects: Agent Card (discovery), Task (stateful unit of work), Message, Part, Artifact.
- Official SDKs: Python, JS/TS, Java, Go, .NET, and Rust.
- A2A covers agent-to-agent communication; MCP covers agent-to-tool communication. They are complementary.

## Start here

- [What is A2A?](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/what-is-a2a/): The problems A2A solves and why wrapping an agent as a tool is not enough.
- [Core concepts](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/key-concepts/): Actors, Agent Card, Task, Message, Part, Artifact, and the three interaction mechanisms.
- [Protocol quick reference](https://a2a-protocol.org/llms-reference.txt): Condensed, agent-readable summary of every core object, RPC method, and task state.
- [A2A and MCP](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/a2a-and-mcp/): How A2A and the Model Context Protocol fit together.

## Specification

- [Protocol specification](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/): Full technical specification, including data objects, RPC methods, error codes, and worked examples.
- [Protocol definition](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/definitions/): Reference page embedding the normative proto and the generated JSON Schema.
- [a2a.proto](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/spec/a2a.proto): The normative Protobuf definition of the protocol.
- [a2a.json](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/spec/a2a.json): Non-normative JSON Schema (2020-12), generated from the proto at build time.
- [What's new in v1.0](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/whats-new-v1/): Changes from v0.3.0 to v1.0.

## Core topics

- [Life of a task](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/life-of-a-task/): Task lifecycle, states, and terminal versus interrupted outcomes.
- [Agent discovery](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/agent-discovery/): How clients find Agent Cards, including the `/.well-known/agent-card.json` location.
- [Streaming and asynchronous operations](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/streaming-and-async/): Server-Sent Events streaming and webhook push notifications.
- [Enterprise features](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/enterprise-ready/): Authentication, authorization, transport security, tracing, and monitoring.
- [Multi-tenancy](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/multi-tenancy/): Serving multiple tenants from one agent deployment.

## Extensions

- [Extensions overview](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/extensions/): Adding capabilities without changing the core protocol.
- [Custom protocol bindings](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/custom-protocol-bindings/): Carrying A2A over transports beyond the three standard bindings.
- [Extension and binding governance](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/topics/extension-and-binding-governance/): The tiered promotion process that keeps the core stable.

## Build an agent

- [Python quickstart](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/tutorials/python/1-introduction/): Eight-step tutorial that builds a working A2A agent from scratch.
- [Tutorials overview](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/tutorials/): Index of available tutorials and courses.
- [SDKs](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/sdk/): Install instructions and repository links for all six official SDKs.
- [Python API reference](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/sdk/python/api/): Generated reference for the `a2a-sdk` Python package.
- [Code samples](https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-samples): Sample clients, servers, and agent framework integrations.
